tour.row.description: Settings root, About section. Row label that reopens the short first-run tour of the remote. Must fit one row.

tour.row_detail.value: A quick guide to the remote.
tour.row_detail.description: Settings root, About section. Detail line under the 'Show the tour again' row. One short sentence.

tour.next.description: Tour. The one button that moves on to the next page of the tour. One word.

tour.step.description: Tour. Progress next to the Next button, e.g. '2 of 6'. {n} is the current page, {total} the number of pages.

tour.skip_hint.description: Tour, first run only. Complete sentence under the page text. {key} is the remote's BACK button drawn as a keycap; keep exactly one occurrence. Must fit one line of the narrative column.

tour.move.title.description: Tour page 1 title. Teaches the arrow keys and OK.

tour.move.copy.value: Use the arrow keys to move between posters and buttons. Press OK to open the one you picked.
tour.move.copy.description: Tour page 1 text, shown beside a picture of the remote's arrow keys and OK. OK is the remote's OK button.

tour.back.title.description: Tour page 2 title. Teaches the Back button.

tour.back.copy.value: Press Back to go back one step. It closes menus, and it leaves the player too.
tour.back.copy.description: Tour page 2 text, shown beside a picture of the remote's BACK button.

tour.menu.title.description: Tour page 3 title. Teaches pressing and holding OK on a poster.

tour.menu.copy.value: Hold OK on a poster to open its menu. You can play it from the start, mark it as watched, add it to your Watchlist or delete it.
tour.menu.copy.description: Tour page 3 text, shown beside a row of posters and an OK key filling up. The actions named are the item menu's own: Play from Start, Mark as Watched, Add to Watchlist, Delete.

tour.controls.title.description: Tour page 4 title. Teaches the player's controls.

tour.controls.copy.value: Press Up or Down to show the controls. Move down to the tabs to see Info and Chapters.
tour.controls.copy.description: Tour page 4 text, shown beside the Up and Down keys and the words Info and Chapters (the player's tab names).

tour.seek.title.description: Tour page 5 title. Teaches jumping and scrubbing in the player.

tour.seek.copy.value: Press Left or Right to jump a few seconds. Hold the key to scrub faster.
tour.seek.copy.description: Tour page 5 text, shown beside the Left and Right keys with the Right key filling up to show a hold. Scrubbing means moving quickly through the video.

tour.profile.title.description: Tour page 6 title. Teaches where Settings and profile switching live.

tour.profile.copy.value: Press Up to reach your profile at the top left, then OK. Change profile switches who is watching, and Settings has everything else.
tour.profile.copy.description: Tour page 6 text, shown beside the Up and OK keys and the menu entries 'Change profile' and 'Settings'.
